blocks.text: Facts here come from the municipality, TransLink or BC Transit, the Ministry of Education and Child Care, and the retailers’ own pages, listed under Sources. Walking and driving times were measured on OpenStreetMap routing on November 2, 2026, from the point named under the table.

items.t: Nearest rapid-transit station: Bridgeport Station, Richmond, reached from South Delta Exchange on route 601.
Nearest bus exchange: South Delta Exchange, named as the terminus on TransLink timetables for routes 601 and 619.
Route 601 Bridgeport Station / South Delta (TransLink): selected trips to Boundary Bay via 12 Ave, Boundary Bay Road, 3 Ave and 67 St.
Route 619 Boundary Bay / South Delta Exchange (TransLink): from South Delta Exchange via 12 Ave, Boundary Bay Road, 3 Ave and 67 St to 1A Ave.
Boundary Bay Regional Park, Delta (Metro Vancouver): Centennial Beach, Dyke Trail, Savannah and Raptor trails.
Diefenbaker Park, 5579 1 Ave, Delta: City park with playground, trails and water park.
South Delta Recreation Centre, 1720 56 Street, Delta: City of Delta facility west of this area.
Tsawwassen Library, 1321A 56th Street, Delta: Fraser Valley Regional Library branch.
South Park Elementary, K-7, 735 Gilchrist Dr, Delta, School District 37; catchment not confirmed.
Beach Grove Elementary, K-7, 5955 17a Ave, Delta, School District 37; catchment not confirmed.
Cliff Drive Elementary, K-7, 5025 12 Ave, Delta, School District 37; catchment not confirmed.
South Delta Secondary, 8-12, 750 53 St, Delta, School District 37; catchment not confirmed.
Thrifty Foods Tsawwassen, 1207 56 St, Delta, in the town centre west of this area.

faq.a: TransLink route 601 runs Boundary Bay trips via 12 Avenue, Boundary Bay Road, 3 Avenue and 67 Street to 1A Avenue, continuing through South Delta Exchange and Ladner Exchange to Bridgeport Station.

faq.q: Can Jared show me homes in Tsawwassen East?
faq.a: Yes. Jared Gibbons, REALTOR® with Royal LePage Little Oak Realty, books private showings across the Fraser Valley and Metro Vancouver. Call or text 604-928-1361, or use the contact form on this site.

faq.q: How do I find out what my home in Tsawwassen East is worth?
faq.a: Jared prepares a home evaluation from recent comparable sales and the condition of your home. Contact him on 604-928-1361 or through the form on this site to arrange one.
